validation.gated_candidate_fixture: Replace supported Grizzly Bears shell while in Hand before source registration/event; Graveyard variant explicitly registers real candidate. No behavior overrides. After admission, helper uses ordinary support::put.

implementation_measurement.scope: 25 newly implemented physical definitions, from first authored-family script creation to this evidence; excludes preceding source/API read period
implementation_measurement.simulation_throughput: not measured by this author; focused scenarios are not simulation benchmarks

source_discrepancies.finding: CounterTypeCount maps each controlled creature to its count of positive counter kinds and sums. Oracle requires the number of distinct kinds in their union. Three creatures each with +1/+1 counters must count as one kind, not three.
source_discrepancies.resolution: Implement union using CounterKind::ALL and borrowed actual/speculative counter queries; test same-kind-on-three-creatures and three-kinds-on-one-creature boundaries. Oracle takes precedence.
